css:
.apx{--navy:#0f172a;--teal:#0d9488;--teal2:#14b8a6;--soft:#f1f5f9;--ink:#1e293b;--mut:#64748b;--line:#e2e8f0;--red:#dc2626;--amber:#d97706;--blue:#2563eb;--violet:#7c3aed}.apx *{box-sizing:border-box}.apx{font-family:Inter,"DejaVu Sans",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);font-size:10.2pt;line-height:1.5;margin:0;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}.apx h1,.apx h2,.apx h3,.apx h4{font-family:"Inter Display",Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.2;margin:0}.apx h2{font-size:15pt;margin:18px 0 8px;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--teal2);break-after:avoid}.apx h3{font-size:12pt;margin:14px 0 6px;color:var(--teal);break-after:avoid}.apx h4{font-size:10.5pt;margin:10px 0 4px;break-after:avoid}.apx p{margin:0 0 7px;text-align:justify}.apx ul,.apx ol{margin:4px 0 8px;padding-left:18px}.apx li{margin:2px 0}.apx b,.apx strong{color:#0b1324}.apx .chapter{break-before:page}.apx .cap-open{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#164e63);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:12px}.apx .cap-open h1{color:#fff;font-size:21pt;margin:4px 0 6px}.apx .cap-num{font-size:9pt;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5eead4;font-weight:700}.apx .cap-open .lead{color:#cbd5e1;font-size:9.8pt;margin:0;text-align:left}.apx .obj{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}.apx .obj span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:8.6pt;color:#e2e8f0}.apx .box{border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px 7px;margin:10px 0;break-inside:avoid;border-left:5px solid}.apx .box .bt{font-weight:800;font-size:9pt;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}.apx .box p:last-child,.apx .box ul:last-child{margin-bottom:2px}.apx .plantao{background:#fff1f2;border-color:var(--red)}.apx .plantao .bt{color:var(--red)}.apx .prova{background:#eff6ff;border-color:var(--blue)}.apx .prova .bt{color:var(--blue)}.apx .perola{background:#f0fdfa;border-color:var(--teal)}.apx .perola .bt{color:var(--teal)}.apx .alerta{background:#fffbeb;border-color:var(--amber)}.apx .alerta .bt{color:var(--amber)}.apx .mnem{background:#f5f3ff;border-color:var(--violet)}.apx .mnem .bt{color:var(--violet)}.apx table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:6px 0 10px;font-size:8.8pt;break-inside:auto}.apx th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;text-align:left;padding:5px 6px;font-weight:600}.apx td{padding:4px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}.apx tr{break-inside:avoid}.apx tbody tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#f8fafc}.apx .fig{margin:10px 0;text-align:center;break-inside:avoid}.apx .fig svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}.apx .fig figcaption,.apx .cap{font-size:8.4pt;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px;text-align:center}.apx .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.apx .formula{background:var(--navy);color:#e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font-family:"DejaVu Sans Mono",monospace;font-size:9.2pt;margin:8px 0;break-inside:avoid}.apx .formula b{color:#5eead4}.apx .ex{border:1px dashed #94a3b8;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px;margin:8px 0;break-inside:avoid;font-size:9.6pt}.apx .ex .bt{font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:9pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}.apx .qs{counter-reset:q}.apx .q{break-inside:avoid;margin:8px 0;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;font-size:9.4pt}.apx .q .en{font-weight:600}.apx .q ol{list-style:upper-alpha;margin:3px 0 0}.apx .gab{font-size:9pt;background:var(--soft);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;break-inside:avoid}.apx .tag{display:inline-block;border-radius:4px;padding:0 5px;font-size:7.8pt;font-weight:700;background:#e2e8f0;color:#334155}.apx /* anexo */
.tb-h{margin-top:12px;font-size:11pt;color:#fff;background:var(--teal);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px}.apx table.dose{font-size:7.6pt;line-height:1.3}.apx table.dose td{padding:3px 5px}.apx table.dose .u{color:var(--mut)}.apx .dose .fq{color:#475569}.apx .dose .br{color:var(--mut);font-size:7pt}.apx .dose .na{color:#cbd5e1;text-align:center}.apx .dose .ol{background:#ccfbf1;color:#0f766e;border-radius:3px;padding:0 3px;font-size:6.6pt;font-weight:800}.apx .dose .xw{color:#b45309;font-size:7pt}.apx .dose .ctl{background:#fee2e2;color:#b91c1c;border-radius:3px;padding:0 3px;font-size:6.6pt;font-weight:800}.apx .small{font-size:8.6pt;color:var(--mut)}.apx .chapter{break-before:auto}.apx{font-size:14px;color:#1e293b;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;overflow-x:auto}.apx table{font-size:12px}.apx table.dose{font-size:11px}.apx .fig svg{width:100%}
